propositions: Commit d9e0f0e733 introduced unconditional top-level imports of rebar_reconciler.git_adapter in _advisory_lock.py:83 and _ref_lock.py:194, breaking standalone-by-path module loading.
The rebar_reconciler package is intentionally absent in the normal installed in-process environment, causing ModuleNotFoundError when standalone-loaded lock modules attempt package-style imports.

Both lock modules (_advisory_lock and _ref_lock) are designed to execute by file path without package context, requiring lazy_load to obtain git_adapter while preserving sys.modules identity with package-context importers.
The bridge preview under sync contention held-out interface test fails at lock acquisition because the standalone-loaded reconciler engine cannot import the top-level package.
